The '''E3-standard starship lifeboat''' was an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] designed by [[His Grace the Duke Gadal-Herm's Safety Inspectorate/Legends|His Grace the Duke Gadal-Herm's Safety Inspectorate]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] used one such lifeboat to reach the world of [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] to begin his self-imposed exile after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
The E3-standard was a lifeboat capable of seating three passengers for four weeks of travel.<ref name="CCS" /> The hull was flanked by four reinforced legs that deployed fully-extended upon landing.<ref name="Deleted">{{Film|III}} Deleted Scene</ref> The pod carried no onboard [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], meaning the E3-standard was useful for one-way trips only.<ref name="db">{{DB|starship|yodaescapepod|escape pod, Yoda's}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:YodaLandsonDagobah.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] lands on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]].]]

Following the funeral of [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]],<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] stowed away aboard a Polis Massa-registered [[super freighter]] carrying grain to [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]]. The vessel briefly dropped out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in the remote [[Dagobah system/Legends|Dagobah system]], where Yoda launched his lifeboat. Undetected and unrecorded, the E3 lifeboat landed on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]].<ref name="CCS" />

Within a year, the lifeboat's sensitive electronic systems were ruined by the natural elements of the swamp world, grounding Yoda on Dagobah forever. Yoda salvaged what he could from the pod, using parts to fashion a [[Yoda's Hut/Legends|simple hut]] in the swamps.<ref name="db" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Minicancell.jpg|thumb|left|The pod on Dagobah]]
This pod is one of two used by Yoda in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']], and the art department ensured the two were visually different from one another. One concept for the 'Dagobah pod' was a rounded pod dragged, [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]]-style, by a rocket.<ref name="db" /> Ultimately, the shots of Yoda's landing on Dagobah were cut from the movie,<ref name="ROTS" /> but were completed for inclusion in the Deleted Scenes section of the DVD release.<ref name="DVD">{{Film|III}} DVD</ref>
